title: A/H科技开盘急跌否定隔夜映射，中石油逆势获双市场确认
summary: 10:12上证跌0.77%、创业板跌3.58%、恒科跌1.77%；佰维、亨通、天孚转为回避，中石油A/H逆势上涨升级为看多候选。信达生物Q3产品收入超47亿元但价格反馈温和。

关键词云图

成长急跌恒科承压存储负反馈光通信抛压业绩兑现油气确认创新药业绩利好未扩散云巨头分化期指回落黄金反证指数分化
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
政策
南方区域电力市场转入正式运行
国家发展改革委10月28日复函同意转入正式运行，电力市场化交易与跨省资源配置再进一步；受益需看电网投资、交易量和企业订单。来源：国家发展改革委。
政策
重型汽车制动与电动车安全标准征求意见
工信部就相关强制性国家标准报批稿和外文版公开征求意见，利于汽车安全部件升级，但征求意见不等于即时收入。来源：工信部。
市场
A/H开盘科技链同步转弱
10:12云端行情显示上证-0.77%、创业板-3.58%、恒指+0.07%、恒科-1.77%；佰维、亨通、天孚分别跌14.01%、5.05%、18.54%，隔夜科技强势未获A/H确认。
港股
信达生物Q3产品收入超47亿元
HKEX 07:30公告显示Q3产品收入超47亿元、同比增长逾40%；10:12股价仅涨0.18%，基本面利好尚未形成明显价格扩散。来源：HKEX。
美联储
Fed维持3.75%-4.00%，两票支持加息
美联储在10票对2票下按兵不动，称通胀仍高；市场继续计入12月加息风险，长端利率与高油价仍约束高估值。来源：Reuters。
美股
现金时段温和收涨，科技和能源相对强
标普500、道指、纳指分别+0.28%、+0.19%、+0.27%；费城半导体指数+1.8%，但亚市早盘纳指100期货回落0.9%。
财报
微软云业务强，Alphabet遭明显负反馈
微软Azure增长和指引超预期，盘后涨逾5%；Alphabet虽云收入强，但利润、自由现金流与广告增速担忧令股价跌逾10%，A/H科技映射必须分化处理。来源：Reuters。
业绩
亨通光电光通信利润高增
Q3收入+27.14%、归母净利润+299.10%，前三季经营现金流+70.57%；10月28日收48.47元、涨4.17%，公告后仍须开盘确认。
业绩
天孚通信AI光器件需求延续
Q3收入+31.50%、归母净利润+55.30%，前三季经营现金流14.62亿元；10月28日收201.43元、涨6.79%，高位追价风险上升。
业绩
中国石油前三季利润增长21.9%
前三季收入2.321万亿元、归母净利润1557.76亿元；H股10月28日收9.95港元、跌1.09%，基本面利好尚未获得同步价格确认。
反证
山东黄金Q3转亏，产销与估值变动拖累
前三季归母净利润31.81亿元、同比-19.60%，Q3归母净亏损3.63亿元；A/H收盘分别约24.99元、17.03港元，维持回避。

美股夜盘行情总结

收盘
美股温和上涨，存储与半导体领跑
标普500+0.28%、纳指+0.27%；SKHY+13.30%、费城半导体指数+1.8%，存储概念榜+8.77%。
盘后
云与AI财报分化压低期指
微软盘后涨逾5%，Alphabet跌逾10%；亚市早盘标普500与纳指100期货约跌0.4%和0.9%，不能把AI链整体包装成一致利好。
油债
油价和长债继续构成估值约束
WTI亚市早盘约101.95美元；10年期美债收益率隔夜约5.03%-5.05%。能源链有盈利支撑，但高利率压制高估值科技。

盘前结论

10:12的A/H开盘反馈否定了隔夜存储与光通信强势可直接延续的假设：创业板、恒科和三只业绩型科技候选同步大跌。 这是风险偏好与候选状态的实质变化。
中石油A/H分别上涨0.83%和3.92%，成为少数获业绩与价格双重确认的方向。 信达生物收入增长逾40%，但股价仅小涨，暂不升级为个股卡。

重点个股关注

佰维存储
SH.688525
回避
事实与状态：Q3业绩高增，但10:12报141.03元、跌14.01%，远低于164元前收，隔夜存储映射被价格否定。
确认条件：仅在收复145.61元开盘价并显著缩窄跌幅、存储板块同步企稳后再降为观察。
风险与失效：经营现金流为负且波动极高；当前明显负面价格反馈不得包装成多头。
亨通光电
SH.600487
回避
事实与状态：业绩仍强，但10:12报46.02元、跌5.05%，已跌破48.47元前收和47.66元开盘价。
确认条件：需重新站上47.66元并出现光通信板块同步修复，才恢复条件关注。
风险与失效：业绩兑现、资本开支与定增压力仍在；弱于前收即维持回避。
天孚通信
SZ.300394
回避
事实与状态：Q3收入与利润增长，但10:12报164.09元、跌18.54%，较201.43元前收出现极端负反馈。
确认条件：至少收复191元开盘价并伴随创业板、光模块板块企稳后再观察。
风险与失效：高价高波动与集中抛压已兑现；未修复前不得因财报增速列为多头候选。
中国石油股份
SH.601857 / HK.00857
看多候选
事实与状态：前三季利润同比+21.9%；10:12 A股13.37元、+0.83%，H股10.34港元、+3.92%，业绩与价格在两地市场同步确认。
确认条件：H股守住10港元且A股维持红盘，油价不出现快速回落。
风险与失效：油价冲高回落、炼化价差收窄或A/H跌回前收均使候选失效。
山东黄金
SH.600547 / HK.01787
回避
事实与状态：Q3归母净亏损3.63亿元；10:12 A股跌2.48%、H股跌4.08%，负面财报获双市场确认。
确认条件：仅在后续经营反证出现且A/H同步收复前收后再降为观察。
风险与失效：自产金产销下滑与公允价值损失压制利润；不得因金价主题包装成多头。

板块轮动看板

确认受益
油气获得业绩、高油价与中石油A/H同步上涨的三重确认。
条件观察
信达生物收入高增但股价仅+0.18%，医药利好暂未扩散。
压力方向
存储、光通信和高估值成长被A/H开盘价格显著否定，优先防守。
验证信号
观察创业板2540点、恒科3780点及科技候选能否收复开盘价。

逻辑链

Fed暂停但高油价与长债高位继续压制成长估值。
隔夜存储、电子元件和光通信强势未被A/H开盘承接。
创业板与恒科下跌，三只科技候选显著跌破前收，形成明确负反馈。
因此切换到油气确认、防守优先；科技等待指数与个股重新收复开盘价。

风险雷达

创业板-3.58%、恒科-1.77%，成长与港股科技风险偏好同步转弱。
佰维、亨通、天孚分别跌14.01%、5.05%、18.54%，财报利好出现集中兑现。
山东黄金A/H同步走弱，Q3亏损不能被金价主题抵消。
信达生物收入高增但价格反应温和，公告利好尚未形成板块确认。
行业Bottom5仍不可得；本轮不把不完整排行当作全市场宽度。

Keyword Map

Growth selloffHSTECH pressureStorage rejectionOptical sellingEarnings fadeOil confirmedDrug earningsMuted reactionCloud splitFutures lowerGold counterevidenceIndex divergence
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicates importance, not return.
Major News
Policy
Southern regional power market enters formal operation
The NDRC approved formal operation on Oct. 28, advancing market-based trading and cross-province allocation. Benefits still depend on grid investment, volume and orders. Source: NDRC.
Policy
Truck braking and EV safety standards enter consultation
MIIT opened consultation on mandatory heavy-vehicle braking and EV safety standards. This supports component upgrades but is not immediate revenue. Source: MIIT.
Market
Technology weakened across A/H after the open
At 10:12, Shanghai was -0.77%, ChiNext -3.58%, HSI +0.07% and HSTECH -1.77%. Biwin, Hengtong and TFC fell 14.01%, 5.05% and 18.54%, rejecting the overnight technology signal.
Hong Kong
Innovent Q3 product revenue exceeded CNY4.7bn
A 07:30 HKEX filing reported Q3 product revenue above CNY4.7bn, up more than 40% year on year; shares were only +0.18% at 10:12, so the fundamental positive lacked price diffusion. Source: HKEX.
Fed
Fed held at 3.75%-4.00% with two hike dissents
The 10-2 vote kept rates unchanged while the statement said inflation remained elevated. December hike risk, long yields and high oil still constrain duration assets. Source: Reuters.
US
Cash indexes edged up; technology and energy led
The S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq rose 0.28%, 0.19% and 0.27%. The Philadelphia semiconductor index gained 1.8%, but Nasdaq 100 futures fell 0.9% in early Asia.
Earnings
Microsoft cloud strength contrasted with Alphabet's selloff
Azure growth and guidance beat, lifting Microsoft over 5% after hours. Alphabet's strong cloud revenue was outweighed by profit, cash-flow and ad-growth concerns, sending shares down over 10%. Source: Reuters.
Results
Hengtong Optic-Electric posted strong optical growth
Q3 revenue rose 27.14% and attributable profit 299.10%; nine-month operating cash flow rose 70.57%. It closed at CNY48.47, +4.17% on Oct. 28, so post-filing price confirmation is still needed.
Results
TFC Optical demand remained firm
Q3 revenue rose 31.50% and attributable profit 55.30%; nine-month operating cash flow reached CNY1.462bn. It closed at CNY201.43, +6.79%, raising chase risk.
Results
PetroChina nine-month profit rose 21.9%
Revenue was CNY2.321tn and attributable profit CNY155.776bn. H shares closed at HKD9.95, -1.09% on Oct. 28, so fundamentals and price have not yet aligned.
Counterevidence
Shandong Gold swung to a Q3 loss
Nine-month attributable profit fell 19.60% to CNY3.181bn and Q3 attributable loss was CNY363m. A/H shares closed near CNY24.99/HKD17.03; avoid remains appropriate.

Overnight US Summary

Close
US stocks edged higher as memory and semis led
The S&P 500 rose 0.28% and Nasdaq 0.27%; SKHY gained 13.30%, the Philadelphia semiconductor index 1.8%, and the storage concept 8.77%.
After hours
Cloud and AI earnings split pushed futures lower
Microsoft rose over 5% while Alphabet fell over 10%. In early Asia, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures fell about 0.4% and 0.9%, so AI cannot be treated as a uniform positive.
Oil & rates
Oil and long yields remained valuation headwinds
WTI was about $101.95 in early Asia and the 10-year Treasury yield was roughly 5.03%-5.05% overnight. Energy profits have support, but high rates weigh on expensive technology.

Pre-market View

The 10:12 A/H tape invalidated the assumption that overnight storage and optical strength would carry through: ChiNext, HSTECH and all three technology earnings candidates sold off sharply. This materially changed risk appetite and candidate status.
PetroChina A/H rose 0.83% and 3.92%, one of the few themes confirmed by both earnings and price. Innovent revenue grew over 40%, but the small share gain does not justify a stock card upgrade.

Stocks to Watch

Biwin Storage
SH.688525
Avoid
Facts and status: Q3 growth was strong, but the stock was CNY141.03, -14.01% at 10:12, far below the CNY164 close, rejecting the storage mapping.
Confirmation: Reconsider only after it reclaims the CNY145.61 open, sharply narrows losses and storage breadth stabilizes.
Risk/invalidation: Negative cash flow and extreme volatility remain; the current negative price signal cannot be framed as bullish.
Hengtong Optic-Electric
SH.600487
Avoid
Facts and status: Earnings remain strong, but it was CNY46.02, -5.05% at 10:12, below both the CNY48.47 close and CNY47.66 open.
Confirmation: It must reclaim CNY47.66 with a broader optical recovery before returning to conditional watch.
Risk/invalidation: Earnings realization, capex and placement pressure remain; stay avoid while below the prior close.
TFC Optical
SZ.300394
Avoid
Facts and status: Q3 revenue and profit grew, but shares were CNY164.09, -18.54% at 10:12 versus the CNY201.43 close.
Confirmation: Reconsider only after reclaiming the CNY191 open with ChiNext and optical-module stabilization.
Risk/invalidation: High-price volatility and concentrated selling are visible; earnings growth alone cannot justify a bullish card.
PetroChina
SH.601857 / HK.00857
Bullish candidate
Facts and status: Nine-month profit rose 21.9%; at 10:12 A shares were CNY13.37, +0.83%, and H shares HKD10.34, +3.92%, confirming the thesis in both markets.
Confirmation: H shares must hold HKD10 and A shares remain positive while oil avoids a sharp reversal.
Risk/invalidation: A rapid oil reversal, weaker refining margins or either listing falling below its prior close invalidates the candidate.
Shandong Gold
SH.600547 / HK.01787
Avoid
Facts and status: Q3 attributable loss was CNY363m; A/H fell 2.48% and 4.08% at 10:12, confirming the negative filing.
Confirmation: Only operating counterevidence plus both listings reclaiming prior closes would justify watch status.
Risk/invalidation: Lower production, fair-value losses and weak price action dominate; gold strength cannot make it bullish.

Sector Rotation

Confirmed beneficiary
Oil has earnings, high crude and synchronized PetroChina A/H gains.
Conditional watch
Innovent revenue grew strongly, but the stock's +0.18% response lacks sector diffusion.
Pressure
Storage, optical links and high-valuation growth were rejected by A/H opening prices.
Validation
Watch ChiNext near 2,540, HSTECH near 3,780 and whether technology names reclaim their opens.

Logic Chain

The Fed pause did not remove high-oil and high-yield pressure on growth valuations.
Overnight storage, components and optical strength failed to carry into A/H.
ChiNext and HSTECH fell while all three technology candidates broke prior closes.
The stance therefore shifts to confirmed oil and defense; technology must reclaim opening levels.

Risk Radar

ChiNext -3.58% and HSTECH -1.77% show synchronized growth-risk pressure.
Biwin, Hengtong and TFC fell 14.01%, 5.05% and 18.54%, showing concentrated earnings realization.
Shandong Gold A/H both weakened; a Q3 loss cannot be offset by the gold theme.
Innovent's revenue growth drew only a muted price response, so the signal lacks sector confirmation.
Industry Bottom5 remains unavailable; partial rankings are not full-market breadth.
